lines.text: God says Israel will no longer quote the sour grapes proverb, because every soul is His and the sinner dies.
The righteous man's violent son eats at the mountain and lifts his eyes to idols, yet lives.
The violent man's son sees his father's sins and does not copy them, so he lives while his father dies.
God will judge Israel by the deeds of their kings, and tells them to repent and live.
